requirement_text.ISS-0216: Letflow.Api.Pagination.decode_cursor/4 trusted its caller-supplied prefix with no non-empty guard -- check_prefix/2's size/starts_with? logic trivially passes when prefix is the empty string, since every decoded cursor starts with the empty string, defeating the cross-endpoint cursor isolation this parameter exists to provide.

task.description: Write a regression test proving ISS-0216's fix (commit 2b0d881 on this branch): check_prefix/2's new leading clause raises ArgumentError when prefix == "", where the pre-fix code (commit 32a8e39, the parent of 2b0d881) silently returned {:ok, ...} for ANY decoded payload when prefix was "". Add test case(s) to test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs under the existing 'decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3)' describe block. Write test/specs/ISS-0216.md documenting the criterion and why the test exists. Mandatory: prove fail-then-pass via a throwaway git worktree checked out at pre-fix commit 32a8e39 -- add the new test there, run it (expect FAIL against the pre-fix code, since no ArgumentError was raised), then run the same test against the fix (this branch, commit 2b0d881+) and confirm PASS. Remove the worktree when done.

result.summary:
Added 2 new tests to test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs (describe 'decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3)' block): (1) a realistic cursor minted under 'T:' decoded with prefix '' asserts assert_raise ArgumentError, ~r/empty prefix/; (2) a payload with no colons at all ('anything') decoded with prefix '' asserts assert_raise ArgumentError, proving the raise is unconditional on prefix == '' alone, not on decoded's shape. Wrote test/specs/ISS-0216.md documenting the criterion, why two cases (not one) avoid the vacuity trap -- a lazier fix could special-case only malformed-cursor+empty-prefix and still leave the real exploit shape (well-formed cursor + empty prefix) open -- and the full fail-then-pass proof.

Fail-then-pass proof, via a throwaway git worktree (git worktree add <scratch-path> 32a8e39, the immediate parent of the fix commit 2b0d881): confirmed via grep that the pre-fix lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex has only the single original check_prefix/2 clause (size/starts_with? logic), no leading prefix=="" guard. Copied deps/ and _build/ into the worktree (not shared/symlinked) plus the new test file, then ran MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs --seed 0 in that worktree:

  Result: 38/40 passed, Failed: 2 tests
  1) ISS-0216 realistic-cursor case: 'Expected exception ArgumentError but nothing was raised'
  2) ISS-0216 no-colons case: 'Expected exception ArgumentError but nothing was raised'

Both failures are the real behavioral defect (check_prefix/2 silently returning :ok), not a name-resolution/UndefinedFunctionError -- proving the test is a genuine regression guard. All 38 pre-existing cases still passed unmodified in the same pre-fix run.

Ran the identical command against the working checkout (feature/WF03-ISS0216-20260826, fix commit 2b0d881 applied): 'Result: 40 passed', 0 failures.

Worktree removed with git worktree remove <path> --force; git worktree list afterward shows only the working checkout; git status --porcelain shows only the two intended new/modified files plus this handoff json.

mix format test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs and mix format --check-formatted both exit clean (no diff). No wall-clock dependency beyond minting a fresh (System.system_time(:microsecond)-based) unexpired cursor for case 1, matching the suite's existing AC3/AC4 pattern; case 2 needs no timestamp at all since the raise fires before extract_expiry_timestamp/2 runs. No unseeded randomness used.
